note: One baked take in FBX/GLB (master timeline). Unity: split into clips by these frame ranges; loop=true clips are seamless.

clips.name: Charge
clips.desc: pressurise: foot pad draws up 25 mm, tank glow rises (game cooldown 6 s)

clips.name: Impulse
clips.desc: release: piston slams 100 mm below rest in 2 f, blast ring, tanks dump

clips.name: Recovery
clips.desc: retract: piston returns to rest, column vents

gameplay: Animation is visual only: it adds no gameplay capability, shot count or timing authority.
